Sara — great to hear. Draft agenda below and I attached our lightweight onboarding deck.
We recommend starting with a sandboxing approach (short-lived hosted sandbox +
provisioned demo dataset) for the first lab, then mapping to Dedicated/Private options
in session two.

Proposed kickoff agenda (90 min):
- 0-10m: Introductions & success metrics (who owns what)
- 10-30m: Redwood platform primer (runtime + routing + caching) — delivered by me
- 30-50m: Integration patterns and recommended architecture for consultancies —
  Marissa to cover customer-facing patterns and handoff checklist
- 50-75m: Hands-on sandbox walkthrough (live demo, pre-provisioned workspace)
- 75-90m: Action items & next steps (owners + dates)

Pre-reads I recommend: onboarding deck (attached), a short checklist for roles (you
can share your spreadsheet) and a one-pager on Dedicated vs Private.

Links: Miro board for the kickoff plan: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVexample/
